value.rationale: The diagonal tensor is the canonical published witness showing that vanishing coordinate sub-hyperdeterminants do not characterize the real-rank-two boundary for order \(4\). The local complete-intersection model explains that failure structurally: all eight equations lose every first-order normal constraint and instead impose independent double normal directions, with exact multiplicity \(256\). This is a natural local invariant of the named counterexample rather than an arbitrary slice or recomputation.
